observations: Photo 0: A dark gray laptop open on a table, screen on with Windows desktop, keyboard visible, backlit keys glowing blue. Background shows shelves with boxed electronics. Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI SLIM GADGETS'.
Photo 1: Same laptop held in hand, angled to show thin profile, screen on, keyboard visible. Same background and watermark.
Photo 2: Close-up of keyboard and touchpad, backlit keys clearly visible with blue glow. No visible branding or model label on keyboard or chassis. Watermark present.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model label in any photo. Seller's text only.
Screen appears to be on and displaying Windows, but no visible touch indicators or bezel markings. Size and resolution cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
No system information visible on screen. No stickers or labels showing CPU. Cannot be confirmed remotely.
No system specs visible on screen. No internal photos or labels. Cannot be confirmed remotely.
Photo 2 clearly shows blue backlighting on the keys.

risks.risk: Incorrect or fake brand/model claim (not a Dell Pro 14 PC14250)
risks.proof: Photo showing the model label on the bottom of the laptop or on the screen bezel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic 14-inch laptop, not as Dell Pro, which affects value.

risks.proof: Video or photo showing finger interacting with screen to confirm touch functionality.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-touch display, which reduces value.

risks.risk: CPU is not Intel Core i7
risks.proof: Screenshot of system information (e.g., Windows About page or CPU-Z) showing the actual processor.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower-tier CPU, which reduces value.

risks.risk: RAM or SSD specifications are incorrect
risks.proof: Screenshot of system information showing actual RAM and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lower specs (e.g., 8GB RAM or 256GB SSD), which reduces value.

risks.risk: Laptop has physical damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Full 360-degree video or close-up photos of all edges, hinges, and bottom casing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential hidden damage, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Screenshot of system information (Windows About page or CPU-Z) showing CPU, RAM, and storage.
Photo or video showing the model label on the bottom of the laptop.
Video showing touch functionality on the screen.
Full 360-degree video or close-up photos of all edges, hinges, and bottom casing.
response.reason: The seller's claims about brand, model, CPU, RAM, and SSD cannot be verified from the photos. While backlit keyboard is confirmed, critical specs are unverifiable remotely. Without proof, the item cannot be accurately priced and risks being misidentified or misrepresented.
